thread:
sam: quick check  real decision needed: gRPC-first internal + REST/SSE public surface via gateway, or REST everywhere? consoles + quotas push me to gRPC-first.
leila: gRPC-first for services, yes. For browser, expose chunked SSE or newline-delimited JSON. gRPC-web is flaky for bidi.
arpit: agree. gateway should be lightweight translator, not do final billing. runtime must emit token metrics. gateway does auth + coarse rate-limit. pass X-RW-Surface and X-RW-Proto-V headers.
sam: example header set: X-RW-Tenant, X-RW-Route, X-RW-Surface, X-RW-Model, X-RW-Trace. make sure console can show "served_by" and latency by component.
leila: canary UX: console toggle to enable/disable translation per-route and show percent + per-surface error rates (transcode_fail, model_error).
arpit: spike plan: 1) proto contract 2) runtime token hooks 3) gateway chunked-sse proxy 4) auto-gen JSON schemas from protos 5) console mock. I'll take the spike and post results tomorrow.
infra-bot: spike ticket created: /boards/infra/spikes/1777770000-gateway-transcode-canary :robot_face:
sam: perfect  include perf numbers and a tiny curl demo for the SSE path.
